items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Is that the project? Yeah. Millenburg? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Used to be good time out there.

ctx.x: Yeah, Tab-a-line. Tab-a-line Kato. They used to play a piano by a routine, though. Then he took that bass ball. See, out on that lake, we used to do good on the lake. I used to play it three times a week out on the lake. I used to play it. Because I had dances often right back on the lake. Where did I made land? There used to be water.
Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Near that, like at the lighthouse out there? Is that the project? Yeah. Millenburg?
Yeah. Used to be good time out there.
